name: kinetic-title
description: A title that types itself in over the picture, word by word or letter by letter, with one word picked out.

parameters.name: sub
parameters.description: a muted line under the title, or None

parameters.name: accent
parameters.description: the word of the title that pick() colours in the accent

parameters.name: max_w
parameters.description: widest the title may be, in scene units

returns: VGroup with .title .sub, .enter(style) the entrance (words, letters or blur), .land() the sub line's fade-in, .pick() the accent change
